sections.heading: Classic Tank Battles. Modern Tactical Gameplay.
paragraphs: ZXTank is an upcoming retro-inspired arcade game from BarkinMad Studios and part of the ZX Series. Command your own battle tank across procedurally generated battlefields where positioning, strategy and quick decisions are just as important as accurate shooting.
Every battle offers a new challenge, combining fast-paced action with tactical gameplay, battlefield objectives and a unique vehicle damage system.

sections.heading: Every Battle Tells a Different Story
paragraphs: No two battlefields are exactly alike. Procedurally generated maps feature a mixture of forests, open fields, villages, ruins, roads, rivers and bridges, creating fresh tactical opportunities every time you play.
Control important locations, collect valuable battlefield upgrades, recover salvage from destroyed enemies and adapt to changing situations as the battle unfolds.

sections.heading: Command Your Tank
paragraphs: Unlike traditional arcade tank games, every major part of your vehicle matters. Damage to the engine, tracks, turret or radar directly affects how your tank performs, forcing you to adapt your tactics throughout each battle.
Recover repair salvage, capture strategic locations and use the terrain to outmanoeuvre your opponents before delivering the final shot.

sections.heading: Multiple Ways to Play
paragraphs: Battle alone against intelligent AI opponents in Solo mode, compete against other commanders in DeathMatch or work together in Team Battle. Every mode takes advantage of the same evolving battlefields and tactical gameplay systems.
Whether you prefer careful planning or all-out action, every match rewards skill, awareness and smart decision-making.
